EmailTemplate.subject: ON THE FLY: How did you describe us?
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
In this season of gratitude, we’d like to thank everyone who participated in our recent client survey. Once again, you’ve rated Flywire world class and provided us with valuable feedback to help further drive efficiency through our innovative products and services.
In a word, how did you describe us? Easy, Efficient, Excellent & Convenient to name a few. You made our day! What you need to know <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/what-you-need-to-know-nachas-changing-regulations?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> Nacha’s changing regulations With information circulating about Nacha’s changing regulations, we wanted to take an opportunity to share a bit about what specifically is changing, what our clients need to know, and how Flywire is responding.
